footer.tagline: Live volleyball statistics. Log every action, follow the score in real time and improve match after match.

hero.subtitle: Track the match from your tablet while you coach —even offline—, share the score and statistics live, and analyse every set in depth afterwards. No more paper sheets.

product.title: Take control of the whole match
product.text: Log every action with the quick grid — designed so one person can coach and record at the same time — or straight on the court map with Rally Map (available on the Analysis plan), with attack and serve trajectories. You choose the detail: every touch or just the actions that end the rally. And you make your substitutions with data, not gut feeling.
product.point1: Score, rotation and server update on their own.
product.point2: Automatic detection of scoring and error runs.
product.point3: Breakdown per player and per court area.
product.point4: Filter the stats set by set.

how.title: From the court to the report in three steps
how.subtitle: No learning curve. Start logging in your very first match.
how.step1Text: Track every play from the tablet with the quick grid or on the court map, with substitutions, timeouts and graded reception. Works offline, in any gym.
how.step2Text: With the Analysis Live plan or a match pass, share the match code and broadcast the score and stats live. Watching it from the web is always free for whoever gets the code.
how.step3Text: When it's over, you get the full match report: side-out and break, rotations, attack maps (if you captured with Rally Map) and much more. With the Analysis plan, export it as a PDF to review with the team.

features.title: Everything your coaching staff needs
features.subtitle: Tools built for coaches, analysts and players.
features.f1Text: Follow the result set by set and how the match unfolds in real time from any device. Broadcasting the live feed is a Analysis Live plan feature (or a match pass); watching it is always free.
features.f2Text: Evaluate individual performance in every area and find your roster's strengths.
features.f3Text: Side-out and break, attack by phase (K1/K2) and by pass quality, reception graded on 4 levels and setter-attacker connections.
features.f4Text: Visualize point and error runs to understand the key moments of every set.
features.f5Text: With the Analysis plan, export match and season reports as PDFs to share with your coaching staff and players.
features.f6Text: Share a simple code and the whole team can check the stats online, no complicated sign-ups.
features.f7Text: Check the aggregated history against each opponent: their rotations, reception against your servers, their attack lanes and danger zones, with the key points always at hand.
features.f8Text: Compare two matches side by side: key metrics, side-out by rotation and who scored the points in each one.
features.f9Text: Automatic warnings during the match: opponent run, player on a streak, set point, stuck rotation or predictable attack, so you can react in time.
features.f10Text: A panel built for the 3-minute break: phases, rotations, opponent trends and the next set's key points in plain language.
features.f11Text: With the Analysis plan, every player gets a full profile: skill radar, attack, serve-reception and physical evolution, inside the season dashboard.
features.f12Text: Log every ball by tapping the court: origin, landing, block and faults. Reception and dig quality follow from where it drops. Available with the Analysis plan.
features.f13Text: Overlay the live score on your YouTube or Twitch stream with OBS, in your team's colours and with your own banners. An Analysis Live feature.
features.f14Text: Invite your staff with a QR code and set permissions: who can track, who can only view. The squad and its photos are shared across every account.
features.f15Text: Your teams and matches travel between your devices and stay backed up in the cloud. You can restore them at any time, including across iPad and Android.
features.f16Text: Swipe or double-tap a player's card to log your most frequent actions in a single gesture, and choose what each one does.
features.f17Text: A card for every player with photo, number, position and measurements, per-match call-ups and a season calendar view.
features.plansHint: Each card carries the plan that unlocks it. Prices and the full table live on the plans page.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Clipeo
faq.subtitle: What the app records, what people see live on this site and what each plan includes. If you can't find your answer, write to us at hola{'@'}clipeostats.com and we'll help.
faq.a1: Clipeo is a volleyball statistics app for iPad and Android. The coach logs every action of the match from the tablet —score, rotation and server update on their own— and, when it ends, the app builds the full report. If you want to, the match can be followed live on this website with a code. Downloading the app and logging matches is free.
faq.q2: How do you keep volleyball stats with the app?
faq.a2: With the quick grid: tap the player, tap the action, done. It is designed so that a single person can coach and log at the same time. If you want more detail, Rally Map (Analysis plan) lets you log on the court map, with attack and serve trajectories. You choose the level: every touch, or only the rally-ending actions.
faq.q3: Which volleyball statistics does it record and analyse?
faq.a3: Everything that happens on court: reception graded on 4 levels, serve quality, attack by K1/K2 phase and by pass quality, block, defence, substitutions and timeouts. When the match ends you get the report with side-out and break, where the points came from, rotations, setter-attacker connections, unforced errors and the attack maps if you captured with Rally Map.
faq.q4: Does it work without an internet connection?
faq.a4: Yes. Capture and statistics work fully offline, with the database on the device itself, so you can log in any gym. You only need internet to share the match live, for the OBS overlay and the public team page (Analysis Live plan), and for multi-device sync and cloud backup (Analysis plan).
faq.q5: How much does Clipeo cost? Is there a free version?
faq.a5: Downloading the app and logging your matches —full capture and stats for every match and set— is free, with no limit on matches or teams. The Analysis plan (€19.99/year or €3.99/month) adds Rally Map, season analysis, PDF reports and cloud backup. The Analysis Live plan (€34.99/year or €6.99/month) adds the live feed, the OBS overlay and the public team page. And there is a €2.99 match pass to unlock a single match, with no subscription. The feature-by-feature breakdown is on the plans page.
faq.q6: Which devices does it work on? Is there an Android app?
faq.a6: Yes: Clipeo is on the App Store for iPad and on Google Play for Android. Both versions share the same features and the same data —a team captured on one syncs and restores on the other—. It is built for tablets, which is where the capture grid really pays off.
faq.q7: How do I share the match live, and how do others watch it?
faq.a7: You turn the live feed on in the app and share the match code, its link or its QR. With that, anyone opens this website and follows the score, the point-by-point and the statistics in real time, free and without signing up. Broadcasting is an Analysis Live plan feature, or a match pass for that match; watching never costs anything.
faq.q8: Can I put the scoreboard on my YouTube or Twitch stream?
faq.a8: Yes. The Clipeo overlay is a URL you paste into OBS as a Browser Source: the scoreboard sits on top of your stream with your team's colours, crests and banners, and updates point by point. Position and size are adjusted from the app, without touching OBS. It is an Analysis Live plan feature.
faq.q9: Can I export the match report as a PDF?
faq.a9: Yes. With the Analysis plan you export the match report, the season report and the player profiles as PDFs, to review with your staff or hand out to the squad. If you only want the report for one specific match, the €2.99 match pass unlocks it too.
faq.q10: Can I share the team with my coaching staff?
faq.a10: Yes, with the Analysis plan. You invite your staff with a QR and hand out permissions: who can log and who only reads. Squad, photos and matches are shared across every account, and multi-device sync keeps it all up to date on each iPad or Android in the team.
faq.q11: Is it useful for scouting opponents?
faq.a11: Yes. The rival report —the one built from your own matches against them— is included for free: their rotations, how they receive against your servers, their attack corridors and their danger zones. With the Analysis plan you can also scout their matches against third parties and build their profile player by player. And during the match you get the smart alerts and the between-sets summary, a panel for the 3-minute break with the keys to the next set in plain language.
faq.q12: Which player data is published on the website?
faq.a12: Only the minimum needed to follow the match: name, number and their actions. Player photos and birth dates never leave the device and never reach the public site —squads include minors and the viewer is an open URL, with no sign-up—. The only image published next to the scoreboard is the team crest, if you uploaded one.

pricing.title: Clipeo pricing and plans
pricing.subtitle: Logging matches and reading their stats is free, forever and with no match limit. The plans add season analysis, reports and the live feed.
pricing.ctaNote: Plans are purchased inside the app, through the App Store or Google Play.
pricing.plansFreeTagline: Everything you need to drop the paper sheet
pricing.plansFreeText: Full match capture with the quick grid and the stats for every match and set: phases, rotations, points curve, in-game alerts and the between-sets summary. No limit on matches or teams.
pricing.plansAnalysisTagline: The whole season, not just today's match
pricing.plansAnalysisText: Everything in Free, plus Rally Map, team history and season stats, player profiles, PDF reports, multi-device sync, cloud backup and sharing the team with your coaching staff.
pricing.plansAnalysisLiveText: Everything in Analysis, plus sharing the match live with a code, the OBS overlay that puts the scoreboard on top of your YouTube or Twitch stream, and the public team page.
pricing.matchPassText: Only want to unlock one specific match? The match pass turns on the live feed, Rally Map and the PDF report for THAT match, with no subscription and no renewal.
pricing.tableSubtitle: The same matrix the app enforces. If something is not listed here, it ships in the free plan.
pricing.noteScouting: The rival report built from your own matches against them ships in the free plan. Capturing the matches the rival plays against third parties —and with them their player-by-player profile— needs the Analysis plan.
pricing.q1: Can I change plan or cancel whenever I want?
pricing.a1: Yes. Subscriptions are managed from your App Store or Google Play account, and you can upgrade, downgrade or cancel there whenever it suits you. Moving from Analysis to Analysis Live is prorated by the store.
pricing.q2: What happens to my data if I cancel?
pricing.a2: Nothing is deleted. Your matches stay on the device and the free features keep working exactly the same; what closes are the paid ones. Subscribe again and you get it all back as it was.
pricing.q3: If I share the team, does my plan cover my whole staff?
pricing.a3: No. Sharing a team hands out access to the data according to each person's role, but the plan always belongs to the account: every member needs their own for the paid features. Joining a shared team requires the Analysis plan.
pricing.q4: Is it billed per team or per account?
pricing.a4: Per account. One plan covers every team and every season you want, with no per-team or per-player cost.

paragraphs: This policy explains what data the Clipeo app for iPad and Android and this website (clipeostats.com) process, and how we protect it.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Clipeo is developed by Pau Hermosilla. For any privacy questions, write to hola{'@'}clipeostats.com.

sections.heading: The app works offline and without an account
paragraphs: Clipeo works entirely offline and without creating an account. If you don't enable any of the features described below, no data leaves your device.

sections.heading: What data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the app, we may process:
list: Account (optional): if you choose to create an account, your email and password are managed with Firebase Authentication (Google).

Content you create: teams, players (name, jersey number, position, birth date, physical measurements) and match statistics. This content is stored on your device and is only transmitted if you enable live sharing (Firebase Firestore), device sync, or cloud backup (Supabase).

Player photos: stored on your device and, if you enable sync, shared with the other accounts that belong to that same team. They are held in a private Supabase space reachable only through short-lived links, and only for the accounts on that team. They are never published on the website, never appear in the live statistics and are never shared with third parties.

sections.heading: Statistics published live
paragraphs: When you enable live sharing from the app, the scoreboard and match statistics are published in real time on this website and are visible to anyone who has the match code. Players' birth dates are never included in statistics published live. The coach decides what to share for each match and can turn off live sharing at any time from the app.

sections.heading: Advertising, analytics and third parties
paragraphs: Clipeo shows no ads, uses no third-party analytics, and we never sell or share your data. We use Firebase (Google) and Supabase solely as data processors to provide the live sharing, sync and backup features you enable; your data travels encrypted (HTTPS). Payments for subscriptions and in-app purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store: we never see or store your card details. Your subscription status is verified on our server (Supabase), tied to your account, to enable the corresponding features.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: This website uses no cookies. We also use no analytics, no advertising and no third-party service that tracks your browsing, so there is nothing to consent to and you will not see a cookie banner.

The only thing we store in your browser is local storage, with a strictly technical purpose: remembering the language you chose and caching the statistics of the matches you look at, so the page does not have to download them again. That data never leaves your device, cannot identify you, and you can remove it by clearing the site data in your browser.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We keep your account data for as long as the account exists. You can delete it, along with your backups and synced data, at any time — see how in Delete account (clipeostats.com/delete-account).

The statistics you publish live are kept for as long as the team exists in the app, so you can browse previous seasons from this website. When you delete a team, its published matches and its public page are deleted automatically.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification and erasure over your personal data by writing to hola{'@'}clipeostats.com.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time; the last-updated date appears at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Option 1: from the app
paragraphs: Open Clipeo, go to your Profile, and open the settings tab. Tap "Delete account". This permanently deletes your account, your cloud backups, and your synced data.

sections.heading: Option 2: without access to the app
paragraphs: Send an email to hola{'@'}clipeostats.com from the address you registered with, with the subject "Delete account". We'll process the request within 30 days and confirm by email once it's done.

sections.heading: What gets deleted
paragraphs: Deleting your account removes:
list: Live-shared matches associated with your account.

sections.heading: What doesn't get deleted
paragraphs: Data stored locally on your device is not deleted when you delete your account; to remove it, uninstall the app. Exported or sent PDF reports are also not deleted, since they are not part of our systems.

sections.heading: Note
paragraphs: Removing the app from your device does not delete your account: follow the process above to delete it completely.

terms.note: This document is an informative template and does not constitute legal advice.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are and scope
paragraphs: Clipeo is an iPad and Android app, available on the App Store and on Google Play, for capturing and analyzing volleyball statistics. This website (clipeostats.com) lets you follow matches live and view reports and statistics shared from the app. These terms govern the use of both.

sections.heading: 2. Acceptance
paragraphs: By using the app or the website you accept these terms of use and our privacy policy. If you do not agree with them, do not use the service.

sections.heading: 3. The app
paragraphs: We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the app. The app offers subscriptions (the Analysis and Analysis Live plans) and a one-time match pass purchase, handled through Apple's App Store or Google Play depending on the platform, and governed by their terms. Apple's standard EULA applies to the app on iPad.

sections.heading: 4. The website
paragraphs: Access to the website is free and requires no registration. Match and team links are public: anyone with the link can view their content.

sections.heading: 5. Content and coach responsibility
paragraphs: Captured statistics belong to whoever captures them. By enabling live sharing or sharing a link, the user authorizes their publication on the website and declares having the necessary consents from the people whose data appears (players' names and jersey numbers, including minors, under the responsibility of the club or coach). You can disable live sharing from the app at any time.

sections.heading: 6. Acceptable use
paragraphs: It is forbidden to use the service for unlawful purposes, to perform massive automated access (scraping), to interfere with the operation of the service or to attempt to access other teams' data without having their link.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: The software, brand, design and generated reports belong to Clipeo or its licensors. The statistics belong to the user who captures them.

sections.heading: 8. Availability and warranties
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is". Statistics are for informational and sporting purposes: we do not guarantee their accuracy or the continuous availability of the service, and we are not responsible for decisions made based on them.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the service. Nothing in these terms limits the rights granted to you by consumer law.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms by publishing the new version on this page with its update date.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Spanish law. When you act as a consumer, the courts of your place of residence shall have jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For any questions about these terms you can write to us at hola{'@'}clipeostats.com.
